Random Seed: a parametric wall sculpture, 3D-printed and airbrushed with UV-reactive paint. Under UV light, it glows.
192 parts. 732 screws. 2.5 months. 80 × 60 × 12 cm, about 11 kg.
Algorithm designs. Hands decide.
